TaskDescription: Visual working memory change-detection task (DANDI description): arrays of coloured squares (set size 1, 2, 4 or 6) were memorised. Fixation (red dot 0.4 s, black dot 0.4-0.5 s jittered), memory array (encoding, 0.8 s), delay (retention, 0.9 s), test array (probe, 2 s), inter-trial interval 1.3-2.3 s. The participant pressed 'Same' or 'Different'. 192 trials per session.
iEEGReference: common intracranial reference (NWB electrodes.reference: 'Common intracranial reference')
iEEGPlacementScheme: clinically indicated depth electrodes in the medial temporal lobe (amygdala, hippocampus, entorhinal cortex, parahippocampal cortex)

Downsampling.Description: downsampled by the authors from the 32 kHz Neuralynx recording to 4 kHz; anti-aliasing filter not documented
